brief.title: A3 poster: Riverside Night Market
brief.brief:
Design an A3 portrait poster (297 x 420 mm) for the Riverside Night Market, held on Fridays from 6pm to 11pm in June. Entry is free. The poster needs a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors" (a drawn placeholder, not a real or fake scannable code). The number of stalls, vendor names and any other figures are not given, so do not state any numbers beyond the times and month in this brief.

Deliver the poster as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and inline SVG only). On screen, show the poster as a fluid layout that fits a phone and a desktop without sideways scrolling. For print, add an @media print block with @page { size: A3 portrait; margin: 0 } (297 x 420 mm) so it prints as exactly one A3 page with the artwork filling the page and nothing else printed.

requirements.description: Names the Riverside Night Market prominently and states Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, in June.
Has a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors".
States no numbers or facts beyond the brief (no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures).

checks.reason: The h1 names Riverside Night Market across three large lines, and the kicker reads 'Fridays in June · Riverside'. The When block shows 'Fridays' and '6pm to 11pm'.
The words 'Free entry' appear in large italic accent type under the When block, and again in the footer copy.

The drawn placeholder box is present, but the poster has overflow:hidden and the box is cut off at the bottom edge in both the desktop and phone screenshots. The 'Scan for vendors' caption is not visible in either screenshot.
The only figures are the brief's times and month. No stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures appear. 'An evening market on the water' adds a small unsupplied detail but no numbers.

The words 'Free entry' appear in the yellow badge in the when section and in the top kicker 'Free entry · Open air'.
A bordered qr-box holds an inline SVG drawn placeholder with finder-style corners, labelled 'Scan for vendors' in the footer. The SVG comment says it is not encoded data.

The brief supplies no facts about the venue, but the kicker states 'Open air' and the free-note says 'No ticket needed to walk in'. The footer copy also asserts what is on each Friday evening. These are facts beyond the brief, though no numeric figures appear.
